Topic 10.3: Manipulative

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Manipulative. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. display the ability to balance the body for kicking technique
2. display manipulative skills through bouncing ball for distance estimation
3. bounce and kick balls safely e) bounce and kick balls for enjoyment Core-Competence

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. display the ability to balance the body for kicking technique
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to display the ability to balance the body for kicking technique. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. display manipulative skills through bouncing ball for distance estimation
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to display manipulative skills through bouncing ball for distance estimation. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. bounce and kick balls safely e) bounce and kick balls for enjoyment Core-Competence
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to bounce and kick balls safely e) bounce and kick balls for enjoyment Core-Competence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”
